claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygetan pets are family members and keeping one creates responsibility; companionship is reciprocal, with animals sometimes choosing families or being adopted when they need homes.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: On Erra, wolves or foxes may join households; prolific, pack-living Moghyay threaten crops and food stores, so sounds and fencing deter them temporarily.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Aboard Toleka, Anéeka says animal reproduction is controlled with twice-monthly hormone drops for both sexes; cat food uses cultured-tissue protein.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
